source.quote: **Finite monotone claim.** If \(\Gamma\) is finite, \(\mathsf S\) is upward closed, and \(\Gamma\in\mathsf S\), then \(d\in\Gamma\) is critical for some route (**contributory**) exactly when \(d\in\bigcup\min\mathsf S\), and \(d\) is **globally indispensable**, \(\Gamma\setminus\{d\}\notin\mathsf S_{E,p}\), exactly when \(d\in\bigcap\min\mathsf S\).

claims.formal: For every finite Γ and every upward-closed S ⊆ P(Γ) with Γ ∈ S: (∃W∈S: CB({d};W)) ⟺ d ∈ ∪min S, and Γ∖{d} ∉ S ⟺ d ∈ ∩min S. Testable on every upward-closed family over |Γ| ≤ 5.

claims.title: Commitments that do no work, and why 'when Γ is infinite'

source.quote: A commitment \(d\) of a candidate that has a route does no work by itself in it when every route stays a route after \(d\) is added to it and after \(d\) is removed from it: a candidate carrying \(d\) then meets (E) exactly when it meets (E) without \(d\), and \(\{d\}\) is critical in no route (B).

claims.formal: NoWork(d) := S ≠ ∅ ∧ ∀W∈S (W∪{d} ∈ S ∧ W∖{d} ∈ S). Then (a) for every W ⊆ Γ: W∪{d} ∈ S ⟺ W∖{d} ∈ S; (b) {d} is critical in no route; (c) a finite block every member of which does no work by itself is critical in no route, so the 'when Γ is infinite' of L313's last sentence cannot be dropped.

not_formalized.quote: A candidate would conflict with the conjecture if an argument not using these four ruled out the claim that it is a non-explanation of its question while these four cannot represent it
not_formalized.why: 'Is a non-explanation of its question' is not a predicate of the semantics, and 'these four cannot represent it' has no definition; only the logical shape can be written.

not_formalized.quote: such that an argument not using (E) rules out the claim that it is an explanation of what its question asks.
not_formalized.why: (Suff) relates Account to 'is an explanation of what its question asks', which the semantics leaves outside itself; formal shape only: ¬∃ℰ [Acc(ℰ) ∧ ¬Dec(t) ∧ some argument not using (E) is in X_j('ℰ is an explanation')].

not_formalized.quote: whose organization no transport can preserve under any contract on its target.
not_formalized.why: The preservation clause is formal (∀C ∀t ¬Faithful_C(t)); 'rules out the claim that it is a non-explanation' is not.

not_formalized.quote: and the distinction does explanatory work.
not_formalized.why: 'Explanatory work' is not defined; the formal part of (Elim) is FC18 and FC96.

not_formalized.quote: a method that rewrites every construction trace as a selection history without loss
not_formalized.why: 'Without loss' is not defined; nor is 'explanation operates on the object layer' in the third item.

not_formalized.quote: A case of finding a new question that treating a contract as a content, something that can be constructed, be new, and be the originative contribution of an episode, fails to capture
not_formalized.why: 'Fails to capture' is not defined; the formal part of (QF) is Argument 5 (FC97).

not_formalized.quote: Neither provenance is reducible to the other
not_formalized.why: 'Reducible' is not defined; the formal part is exclusivity (FC78).

not_formalized.quote: A measure that identifies an outcome, together with a prediction of the outcome from it through a transport faithful on the contract, answers the identification question
not_formalized.why: The candidate made of a measure and a prediction is not specified (organization, commitments, transport), so 'answers' cannot be checked against (E); FC35 takes up only the word 'prediction'.

not_formalized.quote: An inexplicit representation is not an absent one.
not_formalized.why: 'Written in a particular format' has no formal counterpart; formally, (R), Deploy and Build take no format argument (a syntactic property).

not_formalized.quote: Closing an episode is a choice
not_formalized.why: No formal content beyond the syntactic fact that no definition outputs a choice (decisions S21, S28).

not_formalized.quote: An explanatory barrier is an independently characterized domain for which every admitted, non-question-begging enabling condition leaves the relevant capability unavailable.
not_formalized.why: 'Independently characterized' and 'non-question-begging' are not defined.

not_formalized.quote: the coherently posed advanceable challenges
not_formalized.why: 'Coherently posed' and 'advanceable' are not defined, so (U2)'s domain is open.

not_formalized.quote: A claim that no argument rules out is only not ruled out, and gets nothing from that
not_formalized.why: No notion of a claim 'getting' something exists in the semantics; formally, only the absence of any predicate triggered by NotOut (a syntactic property).

not_formalized.quote: That a person can use a claim so, without containing its explanation, is a costly gamble for all creative agents
not_formalized.why: No measure of cost; the text says so ('puts no measure on it').

not_formalized.quote: Whether the combination is new is a question about the literature.
not_formalized.why: About other theories, not a claim of the semantics.
